riderWaite.name: Rider-Waite Tarot
riderWaite.significance: First deck to include full pictorial scenes for Minor Arcana pips
riderWaite.description: Revolutionary deck that transformed tarot by including full scenes with figures and symbols on all cards, including Minor Arcana. Created in 6 months between April-October 1909.
artisticInfluences: 15th century Italian Sola Busca tarot (for pips)
riderWaite.impact: Set the standard for modern tarot design. Over 100 million copies in circulation across 20+ countries.

marseille.name: Tarot de Marseille
marseille.origins: 15th century Italy, developed in Marseille, France
marseille.significance: Traditional European tarot design, prototype for modern decks
marseille.description: The most authentic traditional tarot design, representing centuries of evolution from Italian Renaissance origins to French standardization.

nicolasConver.significance: Standard deck in France, model for modern TdMs

visualCharacteristics.imagery: Bold lines, expressive figures, refined symbolism

historicalContext.development: 17th century - Arrived in Marseille via cartiers

thoth.name: Thoth Tarot
thoth.significance: Integration of multiple esoteric systems in Art Deco style
thoth.description: Esoteric deck incorporating Egyptian symbolism, Qabalah, astrology, alchemy, and Thelemic philosophy in distinctive Art Deco artwork.

publicationHistory.reception: Worldwide following for beauty and occult knowledge

goldenDawn.name: Golden Dawn Tarot
goldenDawn.organization: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
goldenDawn.significance: Foundation for virtually all modern tarot deck designs
goldenDawn.description: Secret society tarot incorporating systematic correspondences between tarot and occult systems including astrology, Qabalah, and alchemy.

hermeticTarot.emphasis: Astrological attributions and Golden Dawn symbolism

goldenDawnTarot.claim: Only truly esoteric deck ever published

goldenDawnMagicalTarot.features: Temple symbolism for Golden Dawn rituals

historicalSignificance.synthesis: Mathers assigned complete correspondences between Tarot and zodiac
historicalSignificance.modernInfluence: Foundation for Rider-Waite and other modern decks
historicalSignificance.systematicApproach: Established occult correspondences still used today
